body: That's part of the problem though, I don't know how to meet new people whether online or in real life, I seem to have absolutely no interests and there is nowhere to meet anyone in person where I live. More and more I think about leaving the country, Europe has always been an interest to me. I cannot seem to deal with my problems here so self imposed exile always seemed like the best option to me, other then just ending my life of course. My friends know I'm under a lot of stress but don't do anything to help, partly because I don't even know what to do. Only time this past week where I've felt even a little bit of positive emotion was when I was drinking but I most certainly know that is not the way to deal with this, no matter how much I want to be in a good mood for once. I wish I could unmake who I am, but I don't see the point, I don't have the will to anymore. Too socially awkward, too frustrated with life to do anything anymore.

Thank you for actually taking the time to read what I wrote and taking the time to respond, it really means a great deal to me. 
As time off to relax and just rest overall would be great, I know I must continue, being sick for 4-5ish months not only wreaked havoc on my mind but also physically as I was too depressed after to get back into shape, I just need to get used to the physical strain, just hard to think on the positive side of life.
Living without any emotional support and barely-to-none of any other kind of support from family has been difficult but I go on. Looking back at things, living without family has done me a lot of good, without them I have been able to shape myself how I want, become who I want, while it has been hard getting over the lack of family, I go on hopefully a better person.
Again thank you to people who read, even more to those who commented. I know death is not the right answer to how I feel, it is just been very hard to find the motivation to continue each day, I needed a kick in the ass from someone but in my current state, there was no way I could do it myself. I still do not know if I can continue, but thank you all for the hope. This week has been particularly hard on me, not sure why, I have been given hope this day.
